items.evidence_summary_en: proposal.md uses the 'Calibration Yard' system as the core concept, proposing a seven-layer conceptual design structure: calibration corridor, public benchmark nodes, urban-scenario sandboxes, public-value audit points, developer walk, open-source exhibition/honor nodes, and phased operating zones.

items.evidence_summary_en: geometry/roads.geojson uses the Jing-Zhang Railway Heritage Park green corridor as the north-south spine with east-west缝合 paths; proposal.md transport section describes rail station (Qinghuayuan, Wudaokou, Dazhongsi) and walking/cycling connections; marked as conceptual.

items.evidence_summary_en: proposal.md renewal project list section lists phasable discussable projects (Jing-Zhang Signal Beacon retrofit, AI Origin Community weaving, Dazhongsi industry cluster renewal, Qinghe suture node, etc.); geometry/phasing.geojson encodes phasing; marked as conceptual projects requiring subsequent professional confirmation.
